meta.name: Verify loan documents and score eligibility with Claude and Google Sheets

name: Verify Loan Documents and Score Eligibility with AI-Driven Risk Assessment

parameters.content:
## AI Loan Eligibility & Document Verification

This workflow verifies loan application documents, extracts and cross-checks applicant details, calculates a transparent, deterministic risk score from real financial ratios, and uses AI to generate an instant eligibility recommendation — with every application logged for audit and review.

Risk scoring is deliberately NOT left entirely to the AI. Credit tier, debt-to-income ratio, employment tenure, bank account health, and document consistency are combined into a numeric risk score with a plain formula in code, so the number behind every decision is explainable and reproducible. AI is used where it adds real value: reading messy document text, spotting inconsistencies, and writing a clear, human-readable recommendation and rationale on top of that score.

### Who's it for
- Fintech lenders and credit unions wanting a first-pass automated underwriting layer
- Loan officers who want obviously-good and obviously-bad applications resolved instantly, so they only spend time on the middle
- Compliance and audit teams that need a reproducible, logged rationale behind every recommendation
- Anyone replacing manual document review and spreadsheet-based scoring with automation

### How it works
1. Applicant submits personal details, loan request, and extracted text from their ID, income proof, and bank statement via webhook POST
2. AI reads the three documents, extracts structured data, and cross-checks it against what the applicant declared, flagging missing or inconsistent information
3. Applications with unusable or clearly incomplete documents get an immediate resubmission request instead of proceeding
4. Code calculates debt-to-income ratio, loan-to-income ratio, an estimated monthly installment, and a weighted 0-100 risk score from credit tier, DTI, employment tenure, bank health, and document consistency
5. AI reviews the numbers and documents and writes a recommendation (Approve, Conditional Approval, Manual Review, or Decline), a plain-language rationale, any conditions, and a suggested loan amount
6. Every application is logged to Google Sheets regardless of outcome
7. Approvable applications get an automated applicant email; everything else notifies the internal underwriting team and sends the applicant a status update
8. Webhook responds with the full decision as JSON

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add Anthropic Claude credentials and attach to both Anthropic model nodes
3. Add SendGrid credentials and replace YOUR_SENDGRID_API_KEY in all three email nodes
4. Replace underwriting@yourlender.com with your real internal review team address
5. Switch the Google Sheets HTTP node to the native Google Sheets node with OAuth2, or add OAuth2 credentials directly
6. Replace YOUR_SHEET_ID with your actual Spreadsheet ID
7. Set up your Google Sheet with a LoanApplications tab (column layout below)
8. Activate and POST a test application to the webhook URL

### Requirements
- Anthropic Claude API key (claude-sonnet-4 recommended)
- SendGrid API key for email delivery
- Google Sheets with OAuth2 credentials (LoanApplications tab)
- n8n instance with a publicly accessible webhook URL

### How to customize
- Adjust the interest rate tiers, ratio weights, and risk thresholds in JS - Calculate Financial Ratios & Risk Score to match your lending policy
- Raise or lower the document verification threshold in IF - Documents Sufficient (default: score >= 4)
- Replace the raw document-text fields with a real OCR step (e.g. fetch uploaded files, then call an OCR/Textract-style API) ahead of Stage 1
- Add a second AI reviewer call for large loan amounts as a maker-checker control
- Add an SMS notification alongside email for time-sensitive decisions

### Important note
This workflow produces a recommendation to support human underwriters, not an automated final lending decision. Keep a qualified human in the loop before any adverse action, and confirm the scoring approach meets applicable fair-lending and credit regulations in your jurisdiction before production use.

### Google Sheets Column Layout

LoanApplications tab - row 1 headers:
Application ID | Applicant Name | Applicant Email | Loan Amount | Loan Purpose | Term Months | Verified Monthly Income | Debt-to-Income Ratio | Risk Score | Risk Tier | Recommendation | Suggested Loan Amount | Decided At

## Stage 1: Intake, Document Verification & Risk Scoring

Accepts loan applications via webhook POST, including raw extracted text from the applicant's ID, income proof, and bank statement. All fields have sensible defaults so the workflow can be tested without a payload.

The verification AI (claude-sonnet-4, temperature 0.2 for accuracy) extracts structured data from each document and cross-checks it against the applicant's self-reported name, employer, and income, flagging any inconsistencies or missing documents.

JS - Parse Document Verification Output extracts the AI JSON with a lenient fallback that trusts the applicant's self-reported figures if parsing fails.

IF - Documents Sufficient sends an immediate resubmission request for unusable or clearly incomplete document sets, instead of proceeding with bad data.

JS - Calculate Financial Ratios & Risk Score is pure code, not AI: it computes DTI, loan-to-income ratio, an estimated monthly installment from a credit-tier interest rate, and a weighted 0-100 risk score from credit tier, DTI, employment tenure, bank account health, and document consistency.

## Stage 2: AI Eligibility Recommendation

A Wait buffer respects API rate limits before this call.

The eligibility AI (claude-sonnet-4, temperature 0.3 for consistent, grounded judgment) reviews the applicant's request, the computed financial ratios, the risk score and tier, and any document consistency issues, then writes a recommendation: Approve, Conditional Approval, Manual Review, or Decline.

It also returns a plain-language rationale that references the actual numbers, any conditions required for a conditional approval, a suggested loan amount (which may differ from what was requested), and a confidence level.

JS - Parse Eligibility Output extracts that JSON with a conservative fallback: if parsing fails, the application defaults to Manual Review rather than a silent approval or denial.

## Stage 3: Logging & Decision Delivery

JS - Format Final Application Record assembles the complete decision object and the summary row for the tracker sheet.

Save Application to Google Sheets Tracker appends that row — every application is logged, regardless of outcome, for audit and reporting.

IF - Auto-Decidable branches on the recommendation:
- Approve or Conditional Approval: Send Applicant Approval Email delivers the decision, any conditions, and next steps directly to the applicant, then the webhook responds with the full decision.
- Manual Review or Decline: Send Internal Review Notification Email gives the underwriting team the full context and AI rationale, Send Applicant Status Email lets the applicant know their application needs more time or was not approved, and the webhook responds with the same decision detail — all three fire in parallel.
